scopeLimitations: Licensed miniature exterior/side-profile support only; no manufacturer, caliber, operating mechanism, ammo count, branding, material authenticity or hidden reverse-geometry certification.

silhouetteProportions: Hicks is the Michael Biehn human Colonial Marine in Aliens1986, uninjured appearance. Actor head/upper-body identity comes from film, not NECA sculpt.
Whole body construction is bounded licensed support only; no claim that small/pre-release figure certifies exact actor proportions.
anatomyAndSides: Two human arms/hands/legs; no mirroring or borrowing Hudson anatomy.
Film reference headset/microphone is at the visible anatomical LEFT ear. Exact watch identity/laterality and unobserved tattoos are not established.
headFace: Use the actual Biehn face on viewer RIGHT of film2 and his distinct close-up film1: source-like brows, nose/jaw, light stubble and uninjured visible skin.
Natural subdued nonluminous eyes; no numerical age or named iris hue. Ripley viewer LEFT is excluded from Hicks identity.
hair: Short swept-up brown hair with lighter highlights actually visible on film2; film1 helmet view cannot independently establish hidden hair.
Seed is unhelmeted, with source headset. Toy fair/packaging sculpt hair is not actor identity authority.
costumeConstruction: Green/gray patterned torso/shoulder plates, bare upper arms, belt/pouches, segmented groin protection and light/dark camouflage trousers, knee/shin guards, per labeled Hicks package and Hicks center-right ToyFair.

Two brown/dark boots are visible only in low-scale ToyFair support; exact sole, lace, seam, brand and rear construction remain unresolved. No transfer of Hudson LEFT figure rolled sleeves/skull graphic or footwear.
paletteMaterials: Bounded green/gray worn armor, camouflage cloth and brown/dark footwear; lighting and figure paint preclude absolute colorimetry or actor material certification.
No Nostromo blue coveralls, later videogame incarnation, Halo armor, Bishop white-red sneakers or Ripley gray footwear substitution.
equipment: CG02 may use ONLY the entire compact shotgun at center-left of licensed Arsenal photo: dark angled pistol grip/receiver/short barrel and brown wooden fore-end. Label-specific Hicks package supports association; collective Arsenal prose alone does not.

No wooden shoulder stock, extra magazine/scope/laser/sling, mechanism/caliber/ammo/branding inference. M41A top-left detachable flash overlaps exact muzzle and is not selected as unobstructed full-weapon authority.
distinctiveMarks: Keep only source-visible Hicks armor paint placement in restrained pixel detail; tiny emblem/text remains unresolved.
Exclude Hudson skull chest graphic, package text, toy joints, creature anatomy, convention display and all unqualified tattoo/emblem interpretation.

equipment: Source-visible anatomical LEFT ear headset/microphone from actor film; no watch model/side or unseen tattoo lock.

Optional compact shotgun for CG02: whole dark angled pistol grip/receiver/short-barrel exterior with brown wooden fore-end in the licensed Arsenal view. No shoulder stock, hidden mechanism, caliber or full simultaneous loadout inferred.
